node.statement: Notation and immediate consequences from def-signed-idempotent, def-height, def-visible-set, def-invisible-mass, and def-negative-mass: put C=conv{p_w:w in W}, d_j=dist_1(p_j,C), a_j=P_{vj}, a_j^+=max(a_j,0), a_j^-=max(-a_j,0), nu=nu_v=sum_j a_j^- and delta=delta(P). Exact signed idempotence gives p_v=sum_j a_j p_j and sum_j a_j=1, hence sum_j a_j^+=1+nu. Since v is a hidden top vertex of height H, d_v=H and d_j<=H for every row j. The row-geometry clause in def-signed-idempotent gives ||p_i-p_j||_1<=2+4*delta for all rows i,j; by convexity, every row is within 2+4*delta of every point of C.
